items.title: Lumentum Holdings (LITE) Heads Into An $82.1 Billion All Stock Takeover
items.summary: Lumentum Holdings (NasdaqGS:LITE) agreed to be acquired by Marvell Technology in an all stock transaction valued at $82.1b. Both boards unanimously approved a definitive merger agreement that aims to combine silicon photonics and compound semiconductor operations. The deal is structured as an all equity transaction, so Lumentum shareholders are set to receive Marvell stock instead of cash. items.title: Marvell CEO Defends $115 Billion Lumentum Deal: “Sometimes Being Unorthodox” Pays Off
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMarvell agreed on November 2 to buy Lumentum in an all-stock deal valuing it at $115 billion, leaving Lumentum holders with about a third of the combined company.
